name: STA410H1 — Correction Attribution (MCMC and the EM Algorithm)

steps.template_en: 'MCMC samples are independent.' WRONG! MCMC produces CORRELATED samples. Chain must be thinned or we need larger n. Effective sample size accounts for autocorrelation. Always check trace plots and ESS.
steps.template_zh: 'MCMC样本独立。'错！MCMC产生相关样本。需稀释或更大n。有效样本量考虑自相关。始终检查迹图和ESS。

steps.template_en: Metropolis-Hastings: propose θ*~q(θ*|θ_t). Accept with prob α=min(1, [π(θ*)q(θ_t|θ*)]/[π(θ_t)q(θ*|θ_t)]). Simple version: random walk MH, q(θ*|θ_t)=N(θ_t, σ²). Requires tuning σ².
steps.template_zh: Metropolis-Hastings：建议θ*~q(θ*|θ_t)。以α=min(1,...)接受。简单：随机游走MH。需要调整σ²。

steps.template_en: Convergence diagnostics: (1) Trace plot — should look like 'hairy caterpillar.' (2) Autocorrelation — should drop quickly. (3) Gelman-Rubin: run multiple chains, compare within vs between variance. R̂≈1 means convergence.
steps.template_zh: 收敛诊断：(1)迹图——应像'毛虫'。(2)自相关——应快降。(3)Gelman-Rubin：多链，比组内组间方差。R̂≈1表示收敛。

steps.template_en: EM Algorithm: for latent variable models. E-step: compute Q(θ|θ^{(t)}) = E_{Z|X,θ^{(t)}}[log L(θ|X,Z)]. M-step: θ^{(t+1)} = argmax Q(θ|θ^{(t)}). Guaranteed to increase observed likelihood each step.
steps.template_zh: EM算法：潜变量模型。E步：计算Q函数。M步：最大化Q。保证每步增加观测似然。

steps.template_en: Together: (1) Gibbs sampling — sample from conditional distributions (special case of MH). (2) MH — general purpose. (3) HMC — Hamiltonian Monte Carlo, uses gradients. (4) EM — for MLE with missing data.
steps.template_zh: 一起：(1)Gibbs抽样——从条件分布抽样(MH特例)。(2)MH——通用。(3)HMC——哈密顿MC，用梯度。(4)EM——缺失数据的MLE。

steps.template_en: MCMC revolutionized Bayesian statistics. Before MCMC (pre-1990): Bayesian inference limited to conjugate models. After MCMC: any model is computationally feasible. 'MCMC is to Bayes what CLT is to frequentists.'
steps.template_zh: MCMC革命化了贝叶斯统计。MCMC前：贝叶斯限于共轭模型。MCMC后：任何模型计算可行。'MCMC对贝叶斯如同CLT对频率学派。'
